author: B

components.title: Filter eligible orders
components.what: Exclude the two orders whose status is cancelled; retain shipped and pending orders.

components.title: Calculate regional and total revenue
components.what: For each retained order, compute revenue as units × unit_price, then sum North-region revenue and total retained revenue.

components.title: Compute and format the answer
components.what: Calculate (North revenue ÷ total retained revenue) × 100, round to one decimal place, show brief working, and end with exactly one FINAL line.

log.author: B
log.draft:
Exclude the two cancelled orders (ORD-1478 and ORD-1414), leaving 15 eligible orders.

North revenue:
- ORD-1528: 3 × 119.73 = 359.19
- ORD-1613: 16 × 37.13 = 594.08
- North total = 953.27

Total retained revenue = 15,843.33.

North percentage = (953.27 ÷ 15,843.33) × 100 = 6.0169%, which rounds to one decimal place as 6.0%.

FINAL: 6.0
